messages.english: Review seed allocations and planned pack counts.
messages.translation: Buyekeza izabelo zembewu nezibalo zamaphakethe ahleliwe.

messages.english: Crop planner → Nursery requirements → Seed sourcing
messages.translation: Umhleli wezitshalo → Izidingo zenkulisa yokukhulisa izitshalo → Ukutholakala kwembewu

messages.english: Open the nursery review for saved planned batches, add the batches that can share a seed supply, and enter your allocation and seeds per pack. Review the planned requirements before downloading the CSV. Blank counts stay unknown; these inputs do not record seed stock, place an order or cover all farm seed demand.
messages.translation: Vula ukubuyekezwa kwenkulisa yokukhulisa izitshalo kwamaqoqo ahleliwe alondoloziwe, engeza amaqoqo angabelana ngesitoko noma ukuhlinzekwa kwembewu, bese ufaka isabelo sakho nembewu ngephakethe ngalinye. Buyekeza izidingo ezihleliwe ngaphambi kokulanda i-CSV. Izibalo ezingenalutho zihlala zingaziwa; lokhu okufakiwe akurekhodi isitoko sembewu, akufaki i-oda noma kuhlanganise sonke isidingo sembewu yepulazi.
